features.max_progress_atr: peak direction progress in ATR since flip
features.max_adverse_atr: peak adverse excursion in ATR since flip
features.volume_5s_zscore: z-score of 5s bucket volume vs trailing 5-min history
features.bollinger_width_percentile_1m: causal percentile of BB width (1m, n=20) in history
features.kalman_acceleration_atr_per_s2: Kalman velocity change per second / atr
features.kalman_innovation_zscore: Kalman price innovation z-score (vs trailing 60s median)
features.ema3_ema9_spread_30s_atr: direction-aligned EMA3-EMA9 spread on 30s bars / atr
features.regime_5s_aligned: +1 if 5s regime == direction, -1 if opposite, 0 if neutral
features.regime_30s_aligned: +1 if 30s regime == direction, -1 if opposite, 0 if neutral
features.regime_5m_aligned: +1 if 5m regime == direction, -1 if opposite, 0 if neutral
features.regime_age_1m_bars: bars_in_regime from 1m engine (current regime bar count)
features.adx14_1m: Wilder ADX(14) on completed 1m bars (nan until 28 bars)
features.minutes_since_rth_open: minutes since 13:30 UTC; nan outside RTH

observation_cadence: every 5 seconds from regime flip through termination
episode_start: 1m regime flip (direction change); first obs at flip close_ts
episode_end: opposing 1m flip OR 30-min timeout OR data end
entry_fill_convention: next 1s bar open after observation_time (see labels.py)
